texts.facts: 3.All these petitioners have been appointed as Assistant Surgeons in the Tamil Nadu Medical Services and they were working as Medical Officers in the Primary Health Centres under the control of the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicines. The Central Government has enacted the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and it was implemented all over India with effect from 05.08.2011. The provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 [herein shall be referred to as the Act] mandate the appointment of Designated Officers under Section 36 of the Act to implement the provisions of the Act in district level. The petitioners were appointed as Designated Officers in the year 2011 and as such they have been serving as Designated Officers. While so, by the impugned orders, they have been relieved, transferred and posted in the Primary Health Centres in the Tamil Nadu Medical Services. 4.The learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners were appointed as Designated Officers in the year 2011 and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/05/2025 10:28:19 am ) WP(MD)Nos.14930 of 2017 and 14128 of 2019 2012 in the Department of Food Safety and Drugs Administration and they have been duly working for more than 10 years. They have been permanently relieved from the post of Assistant Surgeons from the Tamil Nadu Medical Services and they have been paid salary from the Food Safety Department. Therefore they have been made as permanent employees of the Food Safety Department. While so, without any reasons, they have been reverted to their parent department that their performances in implementing the Act in the district are not satisfactory. The petitioners / Medical Officers were https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis The new post of Designated Officers were established for a period of one year with further continuance to be made from time to time. They have not been observed permanently. The service rules have not been framed yet. However, a lien and seniority of these Designated Officers are preserved and maintained in their parent department. Therefore, according to the learned Additional Advocate General, due to the urgent implementation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the Medical Officers / Health Officers from Public Health and Preventive Medicines Department were appointed as Designated Officers on temporary basis. Under the above circumstances, I request you to not to delete their name in the combined seniority list of their respective cadres and keep their seniority in your department for further course of action and to confer on them all attendant benefits applicable to their services as per rules in force. 10.The Secretary to the Government, Food Safety and Drugs Administration Department in letter No.25336/M1/2015-3 dated 29.07.2015 has also clarified that till date no one has been absorbed by the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration from their parent Department. 11.The respondents claim that 12 Designated Officers were already relieved to their parent department of Public Health and Preventive Medicines and they have been appointed in their original post. , this Court is of the considered view that once the respective petitioners https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/05/2025 10:28:19 am ) WP(MD)Nos.14930 of 2017 and 14128 of 2019 have joined duty in their parent department, as per the impugned order, by giving letters to the Deputy Director of Health Services, Cheyyar, Stating that they are willing to join duty as per the impugned order at the Government Primary Health Centre, S.V.Nagaram and the Government Primary Health Centre, Peranamalur, respectively and the contempt petition having already been closed after recording the said fact, the question of re-adjudicating the issue at this stage may not arise.
